blockers.title: ROLELESS-NA and invalid-role cases still have no closed language-role axis in fixtureDomainBasis
blockers.counterexample: Let B be a comparison-basis component with platform macOS and a lawful explicit ROLELESS-NA marker. Its set of product-selected DR-118 roles applicable to B is empty: ROLELESS-NA is a sentinel, not a member of the product-selected DR-118 role list. The literal members formula therefore computes B × empty-set × {macOS} × changeClasses = empty-set. The missing-role refusal does not apply because the subject expressly makes ROLELESS-NA valid. Alternatively start with missing roleApplicability: missingMetadata asks for named cells but supplies no role=MISSING coordinate, so the same empty factor has no constructible cell shape. A harness can hash that basis, execute every cell in it, and satisfy G16-14 while never exercising B's change classes.
blockers.measurement: ROLELESS-NA occurs only in the ownership rule, roleApplicabilityBasis, and the honesty ledger. It is absent from the language-role dimension, the members product, missingMetadata, every change class, and every G16 acceptance class. In contrast, the platform repair explicitly introduces platform=MISSING. The sentence that the digest MUST NOT bless an empty-factor omission states the desired result but neither changes the members formula nor defines the required sentinel tuples across platform and changeClass.
blockers.risk: An allowed roleless identity, or an initially missing/invalid applicability relation, can have no component × language-role × platform × changeClass cells. That reopens the affected-component omission that MCICV7-B1 required the pre-mutation basis to close, despite a self-consistent basis digest and exact executed-set reconciliation.
blockers.suggestedFix: Define an effective role axis for every comparison-basis identity: its nonempty applicable DR-118 role set, {ROLELESS-NA} for a valid roleless declaration, or a distinct role=MISSING sentinel for missing/empty/conflicting/out-of-list input. Make fixtureDomainBasis.members explicitly cross that effective axis with every validated/sentinel platform and every changeClass; declare the reserved sentinels exempt from the out-of-list test and bind the resulting tuples into G16-14.

shouldFix.title: Validated platform sets are asserted to be ownership-record custody bytes but have no record member or dependency-custody contract
shouldFix.counterexample: A component manifest declares {linux, macOS}, while a stale committed ownership record carries only linux. One implementation treats the manifest as authoritative because fixtureDomainBasis says platforms ARE read from it; another treats the record as authoritative because selector.authority says it is the only impact authority. The subject names no ownershipRecord.validatedPlatformSets member, source-validation rule, previous/current rule, or manifest-to-record equality check, and unchanged ID-DEP-C6 enumerates only unit maps, sharedSurfaceConsumers, and multiComponentSharedLaneSelection. Both implementations can claim to use the required 'validated platform set' yet produce different basis cells and digests.
shouldFix.measurement: v8 adds validated platform sets to selector.authority, inputCompleteness, and the selectorDecision ownership-record digest, but the ownershipRecord object adds only roleApplicability. ID-DEP-C6 remains the v7 three-member custody enumeration and its consequence discusses only consumer and predicate bytes. The corpus simultaneously says platforms come from the manifest, without specifying the custody/validation join that makes those bytes the same set inside the sole authority.
shouldFix.risk: The platform REFUSE repair has a producing branch, but the valid-path platform domain is not reproducible from one defined authority. A stale or differently validated set can silently omit platform cells or cause cross-implementation disagreement.
shouldFix.suggestedFix: Add ownershipRecord.validatedPlatformSets with its manifest source, D-002 vocabulary validation, completeness, previous/current comparison, self-change, and digest rules; extend ID-DEP-C6 to name those custody bytes. Alternatively keep platforms as a separately digest-bound harness input and stop claiming they are members of the sole ownership record.

shouldFix.title: G16-13 still permits an inputsDigest that omits the new fixtureDomainBasis digest
shouldFix.counterexample: Emit a run-level pre-mutation basis digest and reconcile the executed cells to it, satisfying G16-14. Build selectorDecision.inputsDigest over exactly the three values G16-13 enumerates—ownership-record digest, DR-103 dependency-edge digest, and changeSetDigest—then join that selectorDecisionDigest to every lane and aggregate result. Every authored acceptance class passes even though the selector decision is not bound to the basis digest that selectorDecision[4] now requires.
shouldFix.measurement: The selector output and inputCompleteness add the pre-mutation fixtureDomainBasis digest as a required selector input. G16-14 checks only run-level emission and cell-set reconciliation. G16-13's exhaustive reproduction sentence remains byte-for-byte at the old three inputs and does not include or join the fixtureDomainBasis digest.
shouldFix.risk: Basis evidence can be paired with a selector decision produced under a different or unbound basis. This is an acceptance-oracle omission of the same evidence-binding kind that G16-13 was introduced to prevent, although G16-14 still prevents a completely absent run-level digest.
shouldFix.suggestedFix: Extend G16-13 so inputsDigest reproduces over the ownership-record digest, DR-103 dependency-edge digest, changeSetDigest, and the exact fixtureDomainBasis digest emitted and reconciled by G16-14. Require the same value to be recoverable from the selector decision joined to every result.

verdictStatement: REJECT. The v8 role repair does not define ROLELESS-NA or missing-role values in the corpus members product, so an allowed or invalid empty role factor can still erase a component's change-class cells. The validated-platform custody path and G16-13 basis-digest join also remain incomplete.

authorityOfThisVerdict.note: Independent review only. DR-121 remains OPEN, G16 remains not QUALIFIED, and coordinator disposition is separate.

coordinatorNote: REJECT at 1 blocker / 2 SHOULD-FIX / 1 advisory. Define the role axis as an explicit effective set that uses ROLELESS-NA for valid roleless identities and a distinct MISSING sentinel for invalid applicability, then cross it with every platform and change class. Give validated platform sets one manifest-to-ownership-record custody contract and update ID-DEP-C6. Finally, add the exact G16-14 basis digest to G16-13's inputsDigest reproduction/join. The conflict policy, DEF-WIN disposition, live locator, frozen inventories, roster, and append-only COORD scope check all pass.
